questions.question: Jesus said He did not come to abolish the Law and the Prophets. What did He come to do with them?
While offering a gift at the altar, you remember your brother has something against you. What did Jesus say to do?

answers.text: Leave the gift and go reconcile first
Offer the gift and pray for him after
Bring a bigger gift to make up for it

questions.question: Instead of swearing oaths by heaven, earth, Jerusalem or your own head, what did Jesus tell people to do?

answers.text: Let your yes be yes and your no be no
Make every promise in front of witnesses
Swear only by the name of the Lord

questions.question: People had heard to love their neighbor and hate their enemy. What did Jesus tell them to do instead?

answers.text: Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you
Love your neighbor and keep away from your enemies
Forgive your enemies once they make things right
